review:
John Hunter and the Mayan Gods sends the explorer into the Mayan jungle on a 5x3, 10-payline grid. The base game is a straightforward line slot, and the main attraction is the progressive free spins feature.

As you progress through the bonus, each level reached awards more free spins and higher multipliers, so the round builds momentum the longer it lasts. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a maximum win for this game on its page. The RTP is 96.46%. It's a simple, focused slot, best suited to players who like a single, escalating bonus round rather than lots of random features.
